theorems.name: Submission.dtc_measure_ball_eq_of_null_sphere
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (c : ℝ≥0∞), c ≠ ∞ → (∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → μ (ball 0 r) ≠ ∞) → (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → μ (sphere 0 ρ) = 0 → μ (ball 0 ρ) = c * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n)) → ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → μ (ball 0 ρ) = c * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
